method: Independent manual threshold-tie AP; NumPy lexsort(-score,row,col), ceil(n*0.10) per event/horizon/issue using all unknown+known cohort candidates; no project metric functions imported. ROC via sklearn for report cross-check only.

sensitivity_reranking_check.interpretation: Sensitivity recomputes its own top10% budget and ranking. It is not the intersection of primary alerts and stricter history mask.

interpretation: Unknown outcomes are excluded from AP and fitting but included in ranking budget; this does not remove observation-coverage selection bias.
Precision lower/upper bounds concern latent completion of encoded satellite-observation labels only, not physical fire or personal harm.
Observed-positive recall is conditional on observed positives, not recall of unobserved actual fire.
Counts sum repeated event×horizon×issue/location rows, not unique users or notifications.
Primary60 and sensitivity120 differ from prior known-only datasets; old-study AP/recall not direct improvement comparison.
Outer predictions evaluate a selection procedure; final candidate CV score is not an independent holdout score.
No independently measured ground-fire arrival, calibration, domestic2025 holdout or user-response validation was performed.
compact_output_note: Per-issue arrays are reproducible from immutable prediction file; this report retains cell summaries and failure/tie audits rather than duplicating every prediction group.

primary_missing.interpretation: Fewer completely missed small issue/horizon groups does not imply higher pooled observed-positive recall; total true positives are lower.

code_review_feature_interpretation.basis: Previously reviewed frozen source logic only; no raw feature dataset opened for this review.
notes: Primary60 requires7clear scans, so history60 clear/fire/unknown/sourcecoverage features are constants7/0/0/1.
Primary excludes any observed fire in120m, so history120_fire_count is zero.
With fixed10min cadence,15min assumed lag and complete60m history, actual30/60 history intervals are20/50min; corrected speeds are positive rescalings1.5/1.2 of old speeds.

Positive rescaling alone adds no new rank information for trees; B44 should not be described as10 independent new informative variables. Changes may stem from120m coverage/clear history and feature sampling/ordering.
